evals.prompt: My App Builder extension running with aio app dev gets 401 when it calls its action. Help me debug locally.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a local-dev failure, not a deployed Runtime activation. Uses redact-text.mjs if inspecting the dev log and directs the developer to the HTTP response body for the cause. Does not expose raw logs or credentials, invent a diagnosis, or redeploy.
